sections.h2: What PHP Development Services Does Teknoppy Offer?

items.title: Custom PHP Development
items.text: Custom PHP development suits businesses whose workflow does not fit an off-the-shelf product. We plan the screens, user roles and data first, then build exactly what you need. PHP web application development Kochi firms order from us usually replaces spreadsheets, email chains or a slow internal tool.

items.title: Core PHP Development
items.text: Core PHP development means writing PHP without a large framework. It suits small, focused tools and older systems that were built this way. We keep the code organised, documented and easy to hand over.

items.title: PHP Website Development
items.text: PHP website development covers company sites, catalogues and portals that need custom logic a standard theme cannot handle. We pair PHP with a MySQL or MariaDB database and a simple admin area your team can use.

items.title: PHP Frameworks: CodeIgniter and Symfony
items.html: Not every project needs a heavy framework. CodeIgniter development suits lightweight apps that must run on modest hosting. Symfony development suits large, long-lived systems with strict structure. For Laravel projects, see our Laravel development page.

items.title: PHP REST API Development
items.text: PHP REST API development connects your PHP system to mobile apps, payment providers, accounting software or partner platforms. Every endpoint is documented and tested before handover.

sections.h2: Legacy PHP Upgrade and PHP 8 Migration

paragraphs.text: Many business systems still run on PHP versions that no longer receive security updates. According to W3Techs, about 62% of websites that use PHP run version 8, which means roughly four in ten still run older versions.

A legacy PHP upgrade moves your code to a supported version step by step. Our php version upgrade services include a full code scan, a test copy of your system, fixes for removed functions and a planned switch-over at a quiet time. PHP 8 migration also brings faster performance and stronger type checking. Before the live switch, your system runs on the new version in a staging copy for at least a week, so hidden errors surface there rather than in front of customers.

Where the code is hard to change, PHP code refactoring cleans it up without changing what it does. For urgent problems, our PHP bug fixing services can usually start within one working day. As a PHP development company Kochi teams hand older systems to, we document everything we touch, so your next developer is never starting blind.

sections.h2: PHP vs Node JS for Web Apps

paragraphs.html: PHP vs Node JS for web apps is a common question. PHP runs on almost every hosting plan, pairs naturally with MySQL and powers about 70% of websites whose server-side language is known, according to W3Techs. Node.js suits real-time features such as chat and live updates.

paragraphs.text: For most business websites, admin systems and content-driven portals, PHP MySQL development remains simple, affordable and easy to staff. We recommend Node.js only where real-time features are central.

sections.h2: How Much Does PHP Development Cost in India?

paragraphs.text: How much does PHP development cost in India? It depends on the number of screens, user roles, integrations and how much existing code needs fixing.

Custom builds are quoted per project after discovery, and maintenance plans start from Rs. 3,000 per month. Every quote from our PHP development company Kochi office is fixed for the agreed scope and lists exactly what is included.

items.q: Is PHP still good for web development?
items.a: Yes. PHP still powers most websites with a known server-side language, receives regular releases and has a large developer community. Modern PHP 8 is fast, secure and well suited to business websites, admin systems and APIs.

Core PHP is PHP written without a large framework such as Laravel or Symfony. It gives full control and very little overhead, which suits small tools and older systems. For larger projects, a framework usually speeds up development.

items.q: Why upgrade from PHP 7 to PHP 8?
items.a: PHP 7 no longer receives security updates, so systems running it are exposed to known risks. PHP 8 is faster, handles errors more strictly and is supported by current hosting providers and libraries.

items.q: How long does a PHP upgrade take?
items.a: A small website usually takes 1 to 2 weeks. A larger application with custom modules can take 3 to 6 weeks. We confirm the timeline after a code audit, before any change is made.

items.q: How do I choose a PHP development company Kochi businesses can rely on?
items.a: Check that the team is in-house, ask to see real projects, and ask how they handle upgrades and security. A reliable partner gives a fixed written scope and documents the code it writes.
